title: gymnadenia pyrenaica
intro: Gymnadenia pyrenaica, commonly known as Pyrenean fragrant orchid, is a species of orchid native to the Pyrenees and surrounding mountains. It is a perennial plant with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Gymnadenia pyrenaica include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial effects.
